title: The Long Rally
style: 7-minute progressive arc, ambient piano intro, builds to four-on-the-floor house, trance peak, field-recording crowd outro, male spoken-story NZ/AU lean, 124 BPM, 336 Hz sub on drop, songpal lineage, pickleball cathedral
lyrics:
[Section 1 — Intro, ambient piano, 0:00-1:00]
(field recording: distant pickleball pops, wind, single bird)
(spoken, male, low)
Sixty-two shots. One rally. One breath.

[Section 2 — Slow build, soft kick enters]
The first ten shots are conversation
Eleven through twenty, the question
Twenty-one through forty, the wait
Forty-one through sixty, the gate

[Section 3 — Verse, full house arrangement]
We were not playing pickleball
We were playing each other's patience
Bright yellow ball as the messenger
The kitchen as the cathedral

[Pre-Drop — riser]
(spoken)
shot fifty-eight... shot fifty-nine... shot sixty...

[Section 4 — Drop, progressive trance peak, 336 Hz sub]
(instrumental, no vocals, lead synth carries)

[Section 5 — Breakdown, pad alone]
(male, soft)
She hit it soft
He hit it soft
She hit it soft
He hit it soft
Until one of them blinked

[Section 6 — Final resolution, four on the floor returns]
Sixty-two shots, one rally, one breath
The point ended in a smile
The point ended in a smile

[Outro — crowd recording]
(applause distant, fades)
(spoken)
That was the long rally.
We're still inside it.
